Q1.question: tighter humidity calibration, present statistics retained
Q1.answer: budget statement - the bounded gain envelope (5.9e-10) is smaller than the retained statistical floor (1.3e-09) and the unresolved drift

Q2.question: better frequency reference
Q2.answer: budget statement - the frequency-reference term is negligible in the single-epoch budget and does not propagate into the coefficients

gate.verdict: Uncertainty-budget statement. The humidity-difference uncertainty is dominated by terms that tighter calibration does not remove: the block-duration-dependent paired-bootstrap SE (1.13e-9 at 0.56 h, 5.38e-9 at 24 h) and the unresolved slow 1/R(t) drift (4.4e-9 data-driven, up to 13.4e-9 shape-bounded).
gate.provisional_because: totals depend on the nb 01 (within-campaign blocked cross-validation) and nb 06 (statistical) repairs
gate.not_claimed: no physical anomaly; no universal hardware ranking; no sampling-schedule benefit prediction
gate.guardrail: Uncertainty-budget statement only: reducing the gain sensitivity does not restore a physical claim. The humidity difference remains compatible with the unresolved 1/R(t) drift and with the model-surrogate limits.

A.label: unresolved
A.qualifier: hard boundary; not correctable with this dataset
A.temporal: static over the campaign; no independent monitor
A.effect: limits the absolute scale and baseline and blocks any "Mathar absolutely correct" claim; absorbed by the fitted intercept, so it does not enter the coefficients

A.label: bounded
A.magnitude: dK/K = -5.17 ppm -> offset 5.2e-6, 4.4x the current 1.166e-6; 0.01 nm rounding alone allows +/-6.4 ppm
A.effect: intercept only: dK/K from 1e-9 to 1e-7 leaves d(alpha_H)_read unchanged to four digits

A.label: quantified
A.effect: enters single-epoch n only; negligible for the coefficients

A.label: quantified
A.qualifier: statistical; the decomposition is not source identification
A.magnitude: 1.84e-7; of which measurement noise 1.78e-7 and model nonlinearity 4.4e-8
A.temporal: short-term scatter plus a slow component
A.effect: sets single-epoch precision; the spatial/temporal mismatch inside it remains unresolved

A.label: unresolved
A.magnitude: not separable; folded into the 1.84e-7 residual
A.effect: may contribute to the coefficient difference; must not be quoted as resolved

A.source: Wavelength convention (Mathar 1.762 vs 1.762174 um; anchor 780.24 vs 780.246 nm)
A.label: quantified
A.effect: <= 1e-12 on the coefficients: no recomputation needed, only explicit documentation

B.source: Statistical uncertainty of the humidity difference
B.label: quantified
B.qualifier: conditional on block length; not robust across the resampling procedures examined
B.magnitude: u_stat = 1.30e-09 (SM nominal); 1.13e-09 at 0.56 h blocks; 3.69e-09 at 7.17 h blocks
B.temporal: block-length dependent; the paired-bootstrap SE grows from 1.13e-09 (0.56 h) to 5.38e-09 (24 h)
B.effect: zero is excluded only at 0.56 h blocks; 7.17 h and 24 h blocks include zero

B.label: bounded
B.qualifier: consistent three-branch propagation, joint (g, b) envelope
B.magnitude: SM single-branch endpoint 3.99e-09 (corrected coordinate) vs joint envelope max 1.024e-09 (u_syst 5.91e-10)
B.temporal: assumed constant multiplicative; BME280 +/-3 %RH at 25 C, ~4 %RH over the campaign plus drift
B.effect: moves d(alpha_H)_read by <= 1.02e-9 = 24% of the difference; the envelope is smaller than the retained statistical and drift terms (the SM single-branch quote exceeds it by 3.9x)

B.label: bounded
B.effect: cross-channel coupling is real and the response is not additive: the joint maximum exceeds the triangle sum of the channel-only maxima (H 1.024 vs 0.952e-9; linearised bound 0.915e-9), so a joint envelope is required

B.label: bounded
B.qualifier: feasible envelope only; the two tutorial scenarios leave it at the endpoint gain
B.magnitude: |b| <= delta; envelope vertex b = -0.645 (H) / -0.125 (T) / -0.033 (P); uncentred b = (g-1)X0 = 9.09 %RH at g = 1.303, 2.27x the spec bound
B.effect: the uncentred and the centred-b=0 hypotheses are different assumptions and both exceed the specification at the endpoint gain; only envelope vertices are legal sensitivity slices

B.source: Slow 1/R(t) component of the fringe-ratio anchor
B.label: unresolved
B.magnitude: observed slow component 0.147-0.411 ppm; leverage 2.6-32.5e-9 per ppm; injection +4.37e-9 (data-driven), up to 13.4e-9 (shape bound)
B.temporal: slow (ramp / seasonal); corr(T,t) = 0.743; the 111-day gap separates the two blocks
B.effect: can account for the entire 4.33e-9 difference; it cannot be corrected with this dataset

B.label: unresolved
B.qualifier: model-surrogate limitation, independent of calibration quality
B.magnitude: 91.7% of rows above 25 C; in-domain N = 12,134 (~1.8 day equivalent), January plus 25 February rows; 28 intra-run gaps > 2 h (max ~145 h)
B.effect: the in-domain comparison has limited discriminating power; the full-campaign comparison is an extrapolation and must be labelled as such

B.source: Block duration for the coefficient uncertainties
B.label: unresolved
B.magnitude: physical-time durations 0.6-48 h; row-block L = 156 samples withdrawn (it permits blocks to span the 111-day gap and is a lower bound)
B.temporal: block-duration dependent; sets the statistical uncertainty, not a physical source
B.effect: the paired-bootstrap SE spans 1.13e-9 (0.56 h) to 5.38e-9 (24 h); the duration dependence and the coverage fraction are reported instead of a single value

B.source: K as a reconstruction rather than a calibration
B.label: quantified
B.qualifier: consistency check, not an independent validation
B.effect: confirms that the toolset reproduces the archived pipeline; it does not validate the convention

C.label: quantified
C.qualifier: over the observed interval and bandwidth
C.effect: the surviving applied result; it must stay conditional on the observation interval and bandwidth

C.source: Frequency reference (780 nm / 1762 nm / K convention)
C.label: quantified
C.qualifier: single-epoch budget only; intercept-only in the chain
C.magnitude: 780 nm dn = 1.0e-9; 1762 nm QFR dn < 1e-12; the K convention is intercept-only
C.effect: contributes <= 1e-9 to single-epoch n and does not propagate into the environmental coefficients

C.label: unresolved
C.effect: limits predictive performance over intervals longer than the decorrelation time; it needs independent drift monitoring

C.label: bounded
C.qualifier: campaign property, not a sensor limit
C.magnitude: duty cycle 15.3%; 111-day gap; in-domain ~1.8 day equivalent
C.effect: performance statements must be conditional on the schedule and the environmental range

C.label: bounded
C.effect: small relative to the drift term for compensation; not the binding constraint
